PostToolUse.command: ext="${TOOL_INPUT_file_path##*.}"; if [ "$ext" = "cpp" ] || [ "$ext" = "h" ]; then clang-format -i "$TOOL_INPUT_file_path" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

PreToolUse.command: case "$TOOL_INPUT_file_path" in */third_party/*|*/build/*|*/build-wasm/*) echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit generated or third-party files'; exit 1;; esac
